name: Kirishiro Natsuki
source:
A younger childhood friend who used to live near the protagonist’s house.
Of course, she’s also good friends with Chihaya. She has a personality that’s so cheerful it’s almost too energetic. That’s why she sometimes makes clumsy mistakes, which is her only flaw.
The protagonist often teases her about her short stature.
